notablePrerequisites:
Burning Anger attached to Olivia's Attendants.
Olivia's Attendants does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Olivia's Attendants indestructible.
description:
Give Olivia's Attendants indestructible, if needed.
Activate Olivia's Attendants by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to itself.
Olivia's Attendants triggers, creating that many Blood artifact tokens.
The Bloods enter the battlefield as 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Intruder Alarm triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Olivia's Attendants by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat from step ? for each remaining trigger, skipping step ? on the last trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
